frequency_question: What proportion of highly contested executive agency nominations successfully achieve Senate floor confirmation under divided or narrow-majority Senate conditions?
membership_rule: Cabinet-level or principal regulatory agency head (FDA, CDC, EPA, HHS) nominations that faced intense partisan or procedural resistance, evaluated by final floor confirmation status.
provenance_note: 4 cases named, 5 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 4 named key cases; representative of modern contested health agency confirmations.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier deputies and non-health agencies, but focuses specifically on the high-profile regulatory commissioner dynamic.
skeleton: Contested health/science agency nominations over the last 15 years, noting that unlike Califf or Gottlieb, current polarization and narrow margins create extreme friction, yet executive pressure usually forces a floor vote if the majority party holds the chamber.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 comparable high-friction nominations
validity_reason: Valid through the current Senate configuration and political administration cycle.
